KOJIN Universal Joint

Universal Joint Bearing (KOJIN Universal Joint)

A cross-shaft universal joint used in propeller shafts of automobiles, tractors, trucks, and more.

Items are classified by KOJIN model number per applicable vehicle model, and are listed together with shaft diameter (øD), needle roller housing bore (Di), outer diameter (Do), and overall length (L) specifications.

You can search by vehicle model name or model number.
